inbox.text: The customer cannot find an order. The thread has the order number and the delivery day. The employee can answer from the thread.
The customer wants a person. The thread does not have the account email. One fact is missing.

money.text: The customer wants a refund. The thread has the order number and the reason. The company rule allows that refund.
The customer wants to cancel. The account has two products. The thread does not name the product.

guard.text: The assistant offers a discount. The customer accepts the price and asks how to pay.
The assistant repeats the offer. The customer says they are done and tells the assistant to stop. The customer is angry. Do not name a mental condition.
